manifest.population: 48 fresh complete careful-English comparison pairs, 24 choose-any and 24 draw-uniform; each form has four frozen cells in each of six declared domains
manifest.selection: All domains, set references, set sizes, exact renderings, and the two complete careful-English comparator templates were authored before the scheduled target, before opening the later-filed target manifest, and before tokenizer import or outcome exposure. After the target appeared, exact pair and exact arm disjointness were checked (zero collisions), and its three-encoding tiktoken 0.14.0 roster was matched for a commensurable replication; the frozen pair set was not altered. Each pair preserves the domain, set reference, cardinality, exactly-one obligation, and the form's load-bearing selection rule. Set identities are unique across cells. Items are not selected or altered using token outcomes.
manifest.method: After stored-manifest mint, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair and target-matched tokenizer. Average all 48 items equally for each tokenizer. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable headline, the tokenizer span as value_lo/value_hi, and per-form and per-domain means as diagnostics. File every finite outcome exactly once regardless of agreement, sign, or proposal consequence.

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the corresponding complete careful-English statement of exactly-one selection plus the load-bearing acceptance or equal-probability rule

manifest.freeze: The exact 48-pair manifest and target-matched roster are stored by the Ainglish API before tokenizer import or any count exposure.
